Cape Verde Islands 1995

Championship played out in a tournament between the champions of the nine
islands (the 10th island (Santa Luzia) is not inhabited).

Campeonato Nacional
===================

First stage
-----------

Participants: Group A: Island champions of Santo Antão (Rosariense), São Nicolau (SC Atlético) 
	      and São Vicente (Académica Mindelo).
	      Group B: Island champions of Fogo (Académica), Brava (Nô Pintcha) and Santiago 
	      (FC Boavista).
	      Group C: Island champions of Maio (Académico/83), Sal (Académico) and Boavista 
	      (Académica Operária).
	      Winners of each group qualifies for final.
